title: Open stalk coordinates preserve a commuting square of module morphisms
statement: Let $k:X'\to X$ be a scheme morphism, $U\subset X$ an open subscheme with inclusion $j$, and $T=X'\times_X U$ with projections $p:T\to X'$, $q:T\to U$. Let $M$, $N$, $Z$ be sheaves of modules on $X$, $X'$, $T$, respectively. Let $a:M\to k_*N$, $b:M|_U\to q_*Z$, and $c:N|_T\to Z$ be module morphisms. Write $\eta_j$ and $\eta_p$ for the ordinary restriction-adjunction units, and $c_P:p_*;k_*\simeq(pk)_*$, $c_Q:q_*;j_*\simeq(pk)_*$ for the pushforward composition comparisons, with $c_Q$ using the equality $qj=pk$. Suppose $a;k_*(\eta_p(N));(p_*;k_*)(c)=\eta_j(M);j_*(b);c_Q(Z);c_P(Z)^{-1}$. For $z_0\in T$, put $z=p(z_0)$. Let $a_z:M_{kz}\to N_z$ and $b_{z_0}:(M|_U)_{qz_0}\to Z_{z_0}$ be the additive stalk maps of $a$ and $b$, followed by stalkPushforward. Let $r_o:N_z\to(N|_T)_{z_0}$ and $r_i:M_{j(qz_0)}\to(M|_U)_{qz_0}$ be the inverses of Mathlib restrictStalkNatIso. Let $t:M_{kz}\to M_{j(qz_0)}$ be stalkCongr for pullback.condition and $c_{z_0}:(N|_T)_{z_0}\to Z_{z_0}$ the additive image of the module stalk functor [def-pc-module-stalk-functor]. Then $a_z;r_o;c_{z_0}=t;r_i;b_{z_0}$ as additive maps.

source.place: restrictAdjunction_unit_app_app, germ_restrictStalkNatIso_inv_app, pushforwardComp_hom_app_app, pushforwardCongr_hom_app_app; Mathlib/Topology/Sheaves/Stalks.lean stalkFunctor_map_germ, stalkPushforward_germ, germ_res, and stalk_hom_ext. Generic germ-functoriality portion of the parent Tag 0098 calculation.

proof.text: Define stalkOfHom(f,x,a) as the additive stalk map of a:M→f_*N followed by stalkPushforward. On a section over W containing f(x), stalkFunctor_map_germ and stalkPushforward_germ identify its composite with the input germ as a.app(W) followed by the germ of N over f⁻¹W. This is stalkOfHom_germ.

Using equality on germs, prove stalkOfHom_postcomp for postcomposition by a module morphism; pushforward_map_app and stalkFunctor_map_germ give its equality. Prove stalkOfHom_comp for two successive scheme morphisms: pushforwardComp_hom_app_app is the identity on sections, so the two germ formulas coincide. Prove stalkOfHom_congr for equal scheme morphisms by equality induction: pushforwardCongr_hom_app_app becomes the presheaf identity, and stalkCongr becomes the identity. Also prove pushforwardCongr_refl by extensionality on module sections.

For an open immersion j, apply the germ formula to the restriction adjunction unit. restrictAdjunction_unit_app_app is section restriction from W to j(j⁻¹W). germ_restrictStalkNatIso_inv_app identifies the resulting germ with the inverse restriction-stalk coordinate; germ_res cancels that section restriction. stalk_hom_ext proves restriction_unit_stalk.

Compose the assumed sheaf square on the right with cP.hom; pushforwardCongr_refl and the inverse-hom identity cancel cP.inv. Combine the two pushforward maps on the left by map_comp. Apply stalkOfHom(pk,z0) to this equality. On the left, stalkOfHom_comp and stalkOfHom_postcomp express it as a_z followed by the stalk restriction unit and c_z0. On the right, stalkOfHom_congr for qj=pk inserts precisely the input stalkCongr; stalkOfHom_comp expresses the remaining map as the input restriction stalk unit followed by b_z0. Replace both restriction units by their inverse restrictStalkNatIso coordinates using restriction_unit_stalk. This is the claimed equality.

theorem openRestriction_stalk_square
    {X X' : Scheme.{u}} (k : X' ⟶ X) (U : X.Opens)
    (M : X.Modules) (N : X'.Modules) (Z : (pullback k U.ι : Scheme.{u}).Modules)
    (a : M ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward k).obj N)
    (b : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj M ⟶
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd k U.ι)).obj Z)
    (c : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (pullback.fst k U.ι)).obj N ⟶ Z)
    (h : a ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward k).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction (pullback.fst k U.ι)).unit.app N) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.fst k U.ι) ⋙
          Scheme.Modules.pushforward k).map c =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction U.ι).unit.app M ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.ι).map b ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (pullback.snd k U.ι) U.ι ≪≫
          Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr pullback.condition.symm).hom.app Z ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (pullback.fst k U.ι) k ≪≫
          Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr rfl).inv.app Z)
    (z0 : (pullback k U.ι : Scheme.{u})) :
    let z := pullback.fst k U.ι z0
    let q := pullback.snd k U.ι
    let L0 := RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor (pullback k U.ι).toRingedSpace z0
    let F0 := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} ((pullback k U.ι).presheaf.stalk z0)) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let hp : k z = U.ι (q z0) :=
      congrArg (fun d : pullback k U.ι ⟶ X ↦ d z0) pullback.condition
    (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (k z)).map
        (Scheme.Modules.Hom.mapPresheaf a) ≫
      N.presheaf.stalkPushforward AddCommGrpCat.{u} k.base z ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkNatIso (pullback.fst k U.ι) z0).inv.app N ≫
      F0.map (L0.map c) =
    (M.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hp)).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkNatIso U.ι (q z0)).inv.app M ≫
      (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (q z0)).map
        (Scheme.Modules.Hom.mapPresheaf b) ≫
      Z.presheaf.stalkPushforward AddCommGrpCat.{u} q.base z0
